en: Conditioned by a state that is neither-outflow (na-āsava) and unwholesome (akusala), a state that is neither-outflow and wholesome (kusala) arises by way of root-condition (hetu-paccaya). (Abbreviated. One [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance (avigata).

Conditioned by a state that is neither-outflow and not-unwholesome (na-akusala), a state that is outflow and unwholesome arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is neither-outflow and indeterminate (abyākata), a state that is neither-outflow and indeterminate arises by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither an *āsava* nor indeterminate (*na-āsava-na-abyākata*), there arises a state that is neither an *āsava* nor indeterminate by way of the root condition (*hetu-paccaya*).
(The section based on pairs is one; it is abbreviated. There are three [results] under root, three under predominance … pe … three under non-disappearance.
